item.title: University Portal Management System
item.description:
Overview

A full-stack university portal management system providing role-based access for students, faculty, and administrators. Handles course enrollment, grade tracking, timetable management, and administrative operations.

Key Features

  • Role-Based Access: Separate dashboards and permissions for students, faculty, and administrators.
  • Course Management: Enrollment workflows, course catalogs, and timetable scheduling.
  • Grade Tracking: Comprehensive academic records with GPA calculation and transcript generation.
  • Full-Stack Architecture: Built with React, Node.js, and MySQL for a complete, production-ready solution.

item.title: EcoRoots
item.description:
Overview

A full-stack tree plantation and reforestation initiative platform showcasing a multi-layer architecture with React on the front end, Django and Node.js on the back end, and a comprehensive database layer.

Key Features

  • React Front End: Interactive, responsive UI for users to explore reforestation projects and track tree-planting progress.
  • Django + Node.js Back End: Dual-backend architecture demonstrating versatility across Python and JavaScript ecosystems.
  • Database Architecture: Robust data layer managing plantation records, user contributions, and environmental impact metrics.
  • Full-Stack Showcase: End-to-end implementation demonstrating modern web development best practices.

item.title: GamePay - Full Stack
item.description:
Overview

Full-stack implementation of the GamePay gaming payment platform concept. Built with React on the front end and Node.js with MySQL on the back end, turning the original UI/UX design into a fully functional web application.

Key Features

  • React Front End: Component-based UI built with React for a responsive, dynamic user experience.
  • Node.js Back End: RESTful API server handling authentication, transactions, and data management.
  • MySQL Database: Relational database powering user accounts, payment records, and game catalogs.
  • Full-Stack Architecture: End-to-end implementation from client to server to database.

item.title: CyberSafe - 3D Mobile RPG
item.description:
Overview

Developing an offline 3D educational RPG focusing on gamified cybersecurity concepts. The game is highly optimized for mobile devices.

Key Features

  • Mobile-Optimized Mechanics: Engineered interactive UI elements, including a responsive password strength analyzer custom-built for mobile keyboard overlays.
  • Performance Optimization: Executed extensive mobile performance optimizations utilizing static batching, mesh compression, and GPU instancing to maximize framerates.

item.title: Neon Dash - 3D Endless Runner
item.description:
Overview

Neon Dash is a high-speed 3D platformer endless runner developed in Unreal Engine 5.7. Players control a futuristic runner traversing floating neon tracks high above a cyberpunk metropolis, dodging dynamic vertical obstacles and collecting energy cores to maintain speed.

Key Features

  • Dynamic Procedural Generation: Implemented a highly optimized level spawner that procedurally generates tracks, obstacles, and power-ups, ensuring a unique path for every run while maintaining constant memory usage.
  • Physics-Based Fluid Movement: Programmed custom character movement physics using C++ to achieve tight, responsive controls including wall-running, sliding, and double-jumping.
  • Visual Effects & Materials: Authored stylized neon materials and particle effects in Unreal Engine to create a vibrant cyberpunk aesthetic with high-speed motion blur and global illumination.
  • Unreal Engine 5.7 Architecture: Utilized a hybrid C++ and Blueprint system to balance performance and rapid prototyping.

item.title: Cyberborn: Cyberpunk Survival
item.description:
Overview

Cyberborn is an open-world 3D cyberpunk survival game developed in Unreal Engine 5.7. Utilizing the AAA assets from the Cyberpunk MEGApack Environment Bundle, the game drops players into a vast, rain-slicked neon metropolis where they must gather energy cores, craft shelter/defenses, and survive against rogue synthetics patrolling the streets.

Key Features

  • Survival & Crafting Mechanics: Implemented survival attributes (hunger, thirst, shield energy, and stamina) paired with an intuitive modular crafting and grid-based base-building system.
  • Environment Bundle Integration: Integrated the Cyberpunk MEGApack Environment assets using customized PBR master materials, volumetric rain/fog, and interactive neon signs to establish a rich, rain-soaked sci-fi atmosphere.
  • Optimization for Open World: Achieved playable framerates by leveraging Unreal Engine 5.7’s Nanite virtualized geometry and Lumen global illumination, along with aggressive Hierarchical Level of Detail (HLOD) and custom draw distance tuning.
  • AI Rogue Synthetics: Programmed combat-ready AI enemies using Behavior Trees and Blackboard states, allowing them to patrol, investigate disturbances, search for players, and coordinate attacks.

item.title: Extinguisher
item.description:
Overview

A mobile firefighter simulation game with one-touch controls and progressive difficulty.

Key Features

  • Gameplay Loops: Developed scoring, fire propagation, and session-based engagement loops for mobile play.
  • UI/UX: Designed a responsive UI and UX across different screen sizes and resolutions.

item.title: First Person Sci Fi Shooter
item.description:
Overview

Built a first-person sci-fi shooter in Unity for WebGL delivery, focusing on playable browser performance, maintainable C# code, and a clean player experience across desktop and mobile-sized viewports.

Technical Highlights

  • Unity WebGL Delivery: Developed and optimized browser-based gameplay for HTML5/WebGL deployment.
  • Gameplay Systems: Implemented combat, movement, UI flows, animations, and feedback loops to support engaging moment-to-moment play.
  • Performance Optimization: Tuned memory usage, loading behavior, and responsiveness to keep the experience stable in the browser.
  • Production Readiness: Used Git for version control, debugging, and iterative improvement during development.

item.title: Astro Rush
item.description:
Overview

A multi-level 3D driving game with physics-based vehicle mechanics and planetary environments.

Key Features

  • Mechanics: Implemented responsive controls, collision detection, obstacle generation, and performance optimization.
  • Environments: Physics-based vehicle mechanics across different planetary environments.

item.title: Archery
item.description:
Overview

A classic archery game where the player aims and shoots at targets. This project was created to demonstrate core C++ concepts including:

  • Object-Oriented Programming (Classes/Inheritance)
  • Memory Management (Pointers/References)
  • Game Loop implementation

item.title: AI-Driven Football Game
item.description:
Overview

Designed intelligent NPC behavior systems using finite state machines for patrol, chase, and attack states to create dynamic and adaptive gameplay.

Technical Highlights

  • Machine Learning: Trained ML models using Unity ML-Agents with Python, exporting via ONNX for real-time inference in Unity.
  • Hybrid Systems: Combined rule-based and machine-learning approaches to improve adaptability and gameplay depth.

item.title: Custom 3D Rendering Engine
item.description:
Overview

A custom rendering engine built from scratch with real-time 3D model importing, scene placement, and camera manipulation.

Technical Highlights

  • Core Systems: Programmed transformation matrices, lighting calculations, projection systems, and viewport controls.
  • Pipeline Development: Developed a streamlined 3D asset pipeline, demonstrating low-level graphics programming and rendering optimization.
  • Technology: C++ and OpenGL.

item.title: Zombie Survival 2D
item.description:
Overview

Zombie Survival 2D is a top-down view shooter where the player fights for survival against waves of incoming enemies. Developed as a semester project for Object Oriented Programming , the game challenges players to defeat zombies while managing limited lives and utilizing strategic power-ups.

Key Features

  • Wave-Based Progression: The game features multiple levels where difficulty increases as new, more dangerous types of zombies spawn.
  • Diverse Enemies: Players face off against distinct enemy types, including basic zombies, blocky Level 2 zombies, and spiky Level 3 variants.
  • Dynamic Power-Up System: A unique “Power Giving Spider” spawns randomly to drop distinct advantages:
    • Shield: Protects the player from damage.
    • Faster Shots: Increases fire rate.
    • Triple Shots: Allows the player to fire three projectiles at once.
  • Scoring & Lives: The player starts with 3 lives, and the score increases as enemies are defeated.

item.title: Zombie Survivor 3D
item.description:
Overview

A post-apocalyptic 3D action-survival game with wave-based combat and resource management.

Key Features

  • Asset Creation: Created all 3D models, environments, and animations from scratch in Blender using PBR texturing workflows tailored for Unity integration.
  • AI & Gameplay: Engineered enemy AI behavior using finite state machines and dynamic pathfinding. logic. Delivered a complete gameplay loop including weapons, health, scoring, and game state management.
